summary: Nora keeps a short account of what each person in a group is like, and reads it in every tag and fire turn in the rooms that list them.
details: Each listed person has one account per group, shown as <character> in that group's rooms that list them.
It is written by that person's own background pass from what they said across the group's rooms, on the same [culture] switch as the room account; no new setting.
limitations: A person who has not said enough yet, or whose pass settled nothing, has no account and nothing is shown for them.
